sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Golf Battle is a game about navigating a virtual golf course and hitting the ball into a hole. Sounds simple, right? But trust us, it's not as easy as it looks. As you play, you'll need to use your mouse to aim your shots, taking into account factors like wind resistance, ball speed, and obstacle placement. It's a delicate balance that requires finesse and strategy to master.

One of the key features that sets Golf Battle apart from other golf games is its use of obstacles. From windmills to tunnels to moving platforms, the course is full of challenges that will test your skills and keep you on your toes. You'll need to use your wits to navigate these obstacles and get the ball into the hole in as few strokes as possible.

But Golf Battle isn't just about individual skill – it's also about strategy. As you play, you'll need to keep an eye on your opponents and adapt your game plan accordingly. Will you try to outmaneuver them and take the lead, or play it safe and wait for them to make a mistake? The choice is yours, and it's up to you to figure out the best strategy for success.
